Whole-table original asset with public/owner/hidden zones; app connection is deliberately outside this package.
Corrected old draft claim that future preparedAge decks go to box: officialsetup puts all3face down centrally. Only filtered-out unused cards go to box.
No fixed city-card capacity or all-board3stage assumption. Own complete2/3/4stage templates select actual recorded face/count/cost/effect.
Unknown/null/0 remain distinct; visible silhouettes do not invent card quantities or selected decisions.

structureEvidence.access: 8pages downloaded/text inspected; component/Wonder and fullsetup diagrams directly viewed
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 3–7players; all3decks prepared face-down in centre;7cards/6turns;left/right/leftpass;2/3/4stages with face-down halfcoveredcard;allcity/privatehand/treasury/conflict/reserves/score categories.

structureEvidence.location: seven Day-side Wonder boards and physical cards/coins/conflict tokens
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Whole set physically distinct; no conflict-track pawn; source stage groups sit along lower Wonder board edge.

assetScope: All3–7player cities/Wonder/treasury/conflict/private hand/chosen card, all three prepared Age decks and shared supplies. Own full2/3/4stage Wonder templates. Assets only.

tableModel.edition: 2nd Edition base game only; expansions excluded

layoutSemantics.seatOrder: seven logical seats in clockwise order; assign actual player IDs per session
layoutSemantics.neighborRelations: each player has previous/next active seat as their left/right neighbors
layoutSemantics.inactiveSeats: hide seats above the selected player count; do not assume seat ownership from image
layoutSemantics.logicalNeighborDirection: With seats ordered clockwise and players facing centre, left neighbour is next ACTIVE seat, right neighbour previous ACTIVE seat; when seats hidden, close ring over actual playerOrder. Owner association is explicit.

playerFields.city: public persistent tableau, cards grouped by color with effects visible
playerFields.wonder: public selected Day/Night board, its starting resource, variable 2–4 ordered stages, and card-under-stage attachments
playerFields.treasury: public coins with denomination and total value
playerFields.militaryConflicts: public Age- and neighbor-keyed Victory/Defeat tokens

ageFlow.lastTurn: choose one of two; discard the other face down without coin reward

wonderStage.builtCardAttachment: partially tucked under the matching Wonder stage

2.physicalMeaning: Each constructed stage covers part of one actual chosen Age card placed face-down beneath it; the used card does not also remain in City/hand/discard.

3.physicalMeaning: Each constructed stage covers part of one actual chosen Age card placed face-down beneath it; the used card does not also remain in City/hand/discard.

4.physicalMeaning: Each constructed stage covers part of one actual chosen Age card placed face-down beneath it; the used card does not also remain in City/hand/discard.

wonderStage.unknownSide: Actual board name, Day/Night and stage count are independently recorded. Do not assume all named sides have3stages or copy old-edition stage effects. Templates express all official2/3/4stage geometries without an invented14side rule database.

sharedLayout.preparedAgeDecks: All three separately prepared I/II/III decks are placed face down centrally during setup (rule p3). Only current Age is dealt; filtered-out cards are boxed. No invented current draw pile after all its cards have been dealt.

notes: Whole-table asset package, not application connection or rule automation.
All seven player stations have actual scope/field/component links; unused seats hide by count.
2/3/4stage templates preserve card-under-stage geometry; actual named-board costs/effects come from the recorded copy, not unverified lookup.
identityInvariants: One physical card ends in a constructed city, one Wonder stage, a passing packet, chosen staging or discard, never two at once.
A tucked construction card stays face down; its building identity is not a publicly constructed building/effect.
Draft hand/choice is owner-private until real simultaneous reveal. Mid-pass packets track sender/recipient/committed state so reopening does not pass twice.
All3Age decks are prepared separately; filtered-out cards and unused guilds are boxed without inventing hidden identities.
Equal military strength gives no token; do not infer a defeat from absence. Record exact pair already resolved during partial Age-end processing.
Special extra last-card or discard-build effects get an explicit checkpoint; do not falsely discard their actual pending card when resuming.
